page.layout: One page of text, full width. Running head at top with the page number at its left. Below it: heading and verses of three passages, each heading centred, with a printed ornament between the third passage and the catchword. Catchword in black letter at bottom right.

l.i: Hinc nihil indignum sceptro, nec inutile volvis,
TVRCA ferox sævit, gelidoq; profectus ab Istro
Fortiter hunc Cæsar cohibe, defende Penates,
SIc geris Imperii fasces, ut mitior alter
Te non sit, vires & moderere tuas.
Hoc agis, ut leges populi, pacemq; sequantur,
Et qui te metuant, te quoque, Cæsar, ament.

page.notes: Large initial "I" of IVDICIVM and large initial "S" of SIc are woodcut-style capitals, joined to their words. A printed ornament (decorative tailpiece) stands between the last passage and the catchword; it is not text. The catchword is in black letter and is only partly legible; the reading "Kurtze" is uncertain.
